description: This file contains unit tests for the ACLAction class within the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing ACL actions, access controls, category setup, and bean conversion methods.

classes.name: ACLActionTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing ACLAction functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes a new User bean as current_user.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test case.

methods.name: testACLAction
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of ACLAction object and its attributes.

methods.name: testaddActions
methods.description: Tests adding actions to default actions list.

methods.name: testremoveActions
methods.description: Tests removing actions from default actions list.

methods.name: testAccessName
methods.description: Tests retrieving access names with invalid and valid inputs.

methods.name: testgetDefaultActions
methods.description: Verifies default actions are returned as an array of ACLAction objects.

methods.name: testhasAccess
methods.description: Tests various permission scenarios for hasAccess method.

methods.name: testuserNeedsSecurityGroup
methods.description: Tests whether security groups are needed for given module and action.

methods.name: testsetupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Checks setup and correctness of action categories matrix.

methods.name: testtoArray
methods.description: Verifies the conversion of ACLAction object to array.

methods.name: testfromArray
methods.description: Verifies loading data from array into ACLAction object.

methods.name: testclearSessionCache
methods.description: Tests the clearing of session cache related to ACL.
